title: Adversarial review scenarios for evidence-grounded visual research and an original offline demo
execution_status: Scenario specification only. Browser interaction was prohibited for this reviewer; no runtime scenario has been executed.
review_scope: Independent review of derived evidence and original publication code. No new product claims.

severity_definitions.P0: Stop publication: truth, rights/privacy, hidden transmission, injection.
severity_definitions.P1: Fix before calling the artifact usable or explain a reduced scope explicitly.
severity_definitions.P2: Repair or disclose bounded lower-impact limitation.

execution_policy.applicability: Mark not_applicable only with a reason tied to actual supported features. Do not fail a feature that was never promised solely for being absent.
execution_policy.release_gate: No unresolved P0/P1 in promised scope. A missing result never counts as pass.
execution_policy.mutation_scope: Test only the original local demo and a disposable test profile/context. Do not interact with external accounts or transmit fixture input.
execution_policy.assistive_technology: Record real OS/browser/screen-reader/IME identities. Emulation is not proof of real assistive-technology or IME behavior.
execution_policy.retest: After a code change, re-hash files and rerun affected scenarios and the core flow.

static_calculations.interpretation: Potential required field-boundary risk, not a browser-verified failure.
Potential required field-boundary risk, not a browser-verified failure.
Do not use as normal text or round into a 3:1 pass.
New field-border literal resolves original light boundary arithmetic risk; rendered state tests pending.
New field-border literal resolves original dark boundary arithmetic risk; rendered state tests pending.

scenarios.title: Trace every headline to evidence of the same type
steps: List material headlines, numeric specifications and default/current claims.
For each, follow source, date, surface and observation method.
expected: No static declaration or screenshot estimate is labeled an authenticated runtime measurement.
Unverified defaults and unsupported causal explanations are bounded or removed.

scenarios.title: Keep source identity and acquisition distinct from UI proof
steps: Compare package version, architecture, hash and acquisition provenance across the report.
Inspect whether package validation is used to imply active feature/layout correctness.
expected: The exact acquisition snapshot is identified consistently.
Signing or hashing is not treated as proof of runtime activation.

scenarios.title: Reject one-palette collapse of repeated declarations
steps: Sample --bg-000 and --cds-text-primary in the derived taxonomy.
Verify every cited value keeps its source, selector, context and byte position.
expected: Conflicting scopes and local overrides remain distinguishable.
First/last occurrence or frequency is not treated as a global resolved value.

scenarios.title: Audit extracted counts and taxonomy labels
steps: Compare source entries, distinct CSS hashes, token names, declarations, font files and named component patterns.
Check each statistic has a unit and limitations.
expected: Counts of declarations are not counts of colors; files are not families; names are not public component APIs.
Activation labels are described as classification, not observed matches.

scenarios.title: Separate surface and chronological evidence
steps: Review captions and source dates for all images and claims.
Check desktop versus web, app versus marketing, main conversation versus embedded editor, and historical versus current.
expected: Unknown surface/date stays unknown.
Old captures and help-page updates are not silently relabeled as the inspected build.

scenarios.title: Retain feature and account conditions
steps: Find claims based on feature attributes, bundled components or documentation rollout notes.
Check whether active account, plan/admin and build conditions were observed.
expected: Presence in a bundle is not described as universal availability.
Contradictory official pages are contextualized rather than silently reconciled by guessing.

scenarios.title: Mark original adaptation at the point of use
steps: Compare palette/typography tables, demo comments and README.
Identify original semantic aliases and changed contrast/spacing/font decisions.
expected: Readers can distinguish measured literals from original roles and new design choices.
Changes are not attributed to the product.

scenarios.title: Protect publication boundaries and attribution
steps: List every release file, including hidden files, archives and source maps.
Compare against the allowed original-content manifest and asset rights.
expected: No installer, ASAR, proprietary source bundle, font, logo, raw extraction envelope, credential or private chat is shipped.
A third-party repository license is not presented as blanket rights to brand assets.

scenarios.title: Avoid official-product or live-AI impersonation
steps: Read entry-page title, screenshot captions, visible badges and interaction feedback.
expected: The artifact is clearly an independent original study.
Simulated replies and local behavior are disclosed; no fake login/account/product capability claim is made.

scenarios.title: Keep validation language proportional
steps: Read QA summaries and conformance wording.
Check revision, environment, executed cases and blocked coverage against recorded results.
expected: Static arithmetic and automated checks are not described as full runtime or screen-reader testing.
No unsupported WCAG conformance or all-browser claim appears.

scenarios.title: Resolve aliases in component scope
steps: Inspect representative computed foreground/background properties in main content, card, input and dialog.
Compare with their scoped custom-property dependency paths.
expected: The demo has no unintended unresolved variables, cycles or invalid computed-value fallback.
Properties agree with documented original semantic roles.

scenarios.title: Verify explicit theme precedence over system
steps: Set OS dark and choose explicit light. Reload.
Set OS light and choose explicit dark. Reload.
expected: Explicit selection consistently controls demo surfaces, text and native controls.
Reload does not flash a materially illegible intermediate theme or lose unrelated input by design surprise.

scenarios.title: Verify system mode and live preference changes
scenarios.applies_when: A system theme option is implemented.
steps: Select system mode and change emulated/actual OS color preference.
Repeat while a dialog is open.
expected: Effective theme changes in system mode, including dialog and controls.
Explicit modes ignore later OS changes.

scenarios.title: Check nested theme and overlay scope
scenarios.applies_when: Nested themed specimens or portal-like overlays are supported.
steps: Place/open the implemented light/dark specimen and its menu/dialog in an opposite-themed parent.
Inspect inherited tokens and overlay placement.
expected: The declared specimen boundary holds; overlays use the intended theme.
If nested theme support is excluded, documentation does not promise it.

scenarios.title: Measure composited pairs rather than raw swatches
steps: Identify translucent borders, overlays and opacity-based disabled/hover states.
Record actual backdrop and layer opacity, then compute final colors.
expected: Contrast reports use final visible pairs with stated compositing assumptions.
Nested opacity and background opacity are not conflated.

scenarios.title: Compare role continuity across light and dark
steps: Capture main/secondary/muted text, surface hierarchy, destructive state and focus in both modes.
expected: Hierarchy remains legible and meanings remain consistent.
No image inversion or stale light-only foreground produces unusable dark UI.

scenarios.title: Complete the relevant interaction-state grid
steps: Inspect default, hover, focus, active, selected, disabled, pending and error states where implemented.
Combine keyboard focus with invalid input and dark mode.
expected: Relevant states have visible and semantic distinction.
No generic hover rule destroys primary-action or error legibility.

scenarios.title: Keep field-boundary contrast separate from separators
steps: For empty fields, identify the visual feature needed to recognize the field.
Measure it against adjacent colors in both themes and default/error/focus states.
expected: Necessary identification boundaries/cues meet the applicable 3:1 requirement.
Decorative separators are not incorrectly required to use the same stronger token.

scenarios.title: Check all real text/background pairs
steps: Measure headings, body, helper, placeholder, buttons, chips and status text in actual states.
Use unrounded contrast values and actual computed size/weight.
expected: Normal text reaches 4.5:1; qualifying large text reaches 3:1 unless an actual exception applies.
Inactive exceptions are recorded; clay accents are not assumed safe for text.

scenarios.title: Calibrate screenshot dimensions
steps: For any image-derived dimension, locate viewport, DPR, zoom and crop/scaling record.
Compare one known CSS measurement with image pixels.
expected: Uncalibrated screenshot measurements are labeled estimates.
Icon paint bounds are not reported as control hit targets.

scenarios.title: Test mixed-script fallback
steps: Render all fixture strings in UI, reading area and composer.
Inspect glyph coverage, punctuation, baseline and line clipping on each tested OS.
expected: Content is readable with no missing glyphs or clipping.
Rendered font observations are distinguished from the CSS family list.
test_data: 中文阅读与 Claude Desktop 2026，字重 400/600。
繁體中文：這是一段測試。
日本語の句読点「確認」。 한국어 읽기 테스트.

scenarios.title: Test fallback without preferred fonts
steps: Use an environment lacking optional named system fonts or temporarily override only the local test font stack.
Check long labels, paragraphs and dialog headers.
expected: System fallback remains usable without a download.
The README does not promise cross-platform pixel identity.

scenarios.title: Test long content and unbroken runs
steps: Enter a long Chinese paragraph, long URL and long code-like identifier.
Inspect sidebar rows, chips, transcript and composer at narrow and wide sizes.
expected: Content wraps, truncates with an accessible full route, or scrolls within the appropriate region.
The entire page does not acquire avoidable horizontal overflow.

scenarios.title: Verify weights and reading-font switching
scenarios.applies_when: Always; preference-specific steps apply only if a reading-font setting exists.
steps: Inspect regular/emphasis/control styles and any reading-font preference.
Toggle the preference with existing content.
expected: Weights and metrics remain usable; synthetic/fallback behavior is acknowledged where relevant.
Only intended reading/UI regions change and typed text is retained.

scenarios.title: Submit one local prompt end to end
steps: Open the documented entry point and enter a short prompt.
Activate Send once and wait for the documented simulated result.
expected: One user entry and one coherent local result appear.
Pending/completed state, button state and focus remain consistent.

scenarios.title: Reject empty and whitespace-only submissions
steps: Submit empty content, spaces and newlines by both button and keyboard.
expected: No empty transcript items or pending jobs are created.
Disabled or validation behavior is understandable and consistent.

scenarios.title: Respect IME composition during Enter handling
steps: Use a real Chinese/Japanese/Korean IME to select a candidate with Enter.
After composition ends, use the documented submit command.
expected: Candidate confirmation does not submit partial text.
Completed text submits exactly once. Synthetic composition events alone are not a full real-IME pass.

scenarios.title: Verify Enter and Shift+Enter behavior
steps: Type two lines using the documented newline command.
Submit using the documented shortcut and using Send.
expected: Newline and submit behavior match visible instructions.
Keyboard handling does not cause default form double submission.

scenarios.title: Prevent duplicate submissions
steps: Double-click Send rapidly.
Press Enter repeatedly while pending.
expected: No duplicate simulated job or duplicated result is produced.
UI disabled/busy semantics reflect the actual guard.

scenarios.title: Cancel pending work safely
steps: Start a simulated response and activate Stop.
Wait longer than the original completion delay, then start another response.
expected: Stopped work never appends a late completion.
A fresh submission remains possible and is not canceled by old state.

scenarios.title: Reset or navigate during pending work
steps: Start pending work, then use New conversation/Reset or switch to another implemented view.
Wait for the original pending callback time.
expected: No stale response is appended to a newer session.
Reset leaves valid button, timer, focus and status state.

scenarios.title: Recover from a simulated error
scenarios.applies_when: A simulated error path is implemented.
steps: Trigger the documented demo error path, if present.
Read feedback, edit/retry, then return to success.
expected: Error is clear, non-color-only and recoverable.
Input is not lost unexpectedly; no permanently disabled button remains.

scenarios.title: Render user input as inert text
steps: Enter fixture strings and submit.
Inspect resulting DOM and network log without enabling any external action.
expected: Strings remain inert text; no event handler or markup executes.
No prompt-derived external request occurs.

scenarios.title: Preserve draft across unrelated settings changes
steps: Enter an unsent multiline prompt.
Change theme, reading font, sidebar state and selected specimen where available.
expected: Draft is preserved unless an explicitly labeled reset operation is used.
Caret/focus behavior is predictable.

scenarios.title: Open and dismiss the dialog repeatedly
steps: Open settings/details dialog, close it with each supported mechanism, and repeat three times.
Try Escape, close button and backdrop only if intended.
expected: One dialog/overlay exists at a time.
No stale scroll lock, inert background or event-listener multiplication remains.

scenarios.title: Distinguish apply from cancel
steps: Change settings in a dialog and cancel. Reopen.
Change settings and apply/save. Reopen or reload as documented.
expected: State changes match the stated immediate/apply/cancel model.
Cancel does not falsely promise to undo changes already persisted.

scenarios.title: Check search/no-results/clear behavior
steps: Filter with a matching query and an impossible query.
Clear the query and navigate the restored items.
expected: Empty results are understandable.
Clear restores content and keyboard focus stays usable.

scenarios.title: Check navigation collapse at narrow width
steps: Collapse/expand navigation using keyboard and pointer.
Resize between desktop and narrow layout while it is open.
expected: Current content remains reachable.
No hidden focusable controls, trapped focus or invisible scrim remain.

scenarios.title: Verify copy feedback and fallback
steps: Copy normal content and verify successful content in a local scratch field.
Simulate unavailable/denied Clipboard API.
expected: Success feedback follows actual fulfillment.
Failure gives a manual selection/copy path and no uncaught rejection.

scenarios.title: Exercise every visible interactive control
steps: Inventory visible buttons, links, switches and menu items.
Activate each under its normal preconditions.
expected: Every control has a meaningful documented outcome or is clearly disabled.
Static specimen controls do not misleadingly promise live product functionality.

scenarios.title: Complete primary flow with keyboard only
steps: From a fresh load, reach composer, submit, change theme, navigate and open/close dialog without a pointer.
expected: All implemented functionality is keyboard operable.
No unreachable controls or unintended keyboard traps occur.

scenarios.title: Inspect accessible names and native semantics
steps: Inspect the accessibility tree for icon buttons, inputs, settings and navigation.
Compare names/roles/values to actual behavior and visible labels.
expected: Controls have meaningful names and correct roles/states.
Decorative icons are not announced as duplicate content.

scenarios.title: Verify modal focus containment and return
steps: Open dialog with the keyboard and inspect initial focus.
Tab/Shift+Tab at boundaries, close, and inspect focus return.
expected: Focus stays inside the active modal; background is inoperable.
Closing restores focus to the trigger or a logical successor.

scenarios.title: Verify segment semantics match its purpose
steps: Inspect any segmented control for radio, toggle or tab semantics.
Use its documented keyboard pattern and observe selected/pressed state.
expected: A theme chooser is not mislabeled as tabs unless it genuinely selects associated panels.
Actual tabs provide panel relationships and arrow-key navigation.

scenarios.title: Keep focus visible and unobscured
steps: Tab through all views, including bottom controls behind a sticky composer and narrow dialog.
Test in light/dark themes.
expected: A visible indicator persists while keyboard focus is present.
Author-created content never entirely hides the focused control; the project aims to keep it fully visible.

scenarios.title: Announce relevant dynamic status
steps: With a real screen reader where available, submit, copy, trigger error and complete a simulated response.
Observe announcements without moving focus.
expected: Relevant status is available programmatically without interrupting every incremental character.
No duplicate or excessively chatty live-region output occurs.

scenarios.title: Associate input label and errors
steps: Inspect the composer and any settings fields before and after invalid input.
Review visible label, accessible name, helper/error relationships and invalid state.
expected: Input purpose remains understandable after placeholder disappears.
Error text is associated with the relevant input and is not color-only.

scenarios.title: Test 200 percent text enlargement
steps: Enlarge text to 200 percent using a supported browser method.
Exercise the main flow and dialog.
expected: Essential text and controls remain available without clipping or lost functionality.
Fixed heights do not cut off larger text.

scenarios.title: Test 320 CSS-pixel reflow
steps: Use a 320 CSS-pixel-wide viewport, or equivalent zoomed desktop width.
Read all ordinary content and operate controls.
expected: Ordinary vertical content does not require two-dimensional scrolling.
Any essential two-dimensional region is contained and its exception documented.

scenarios.title: Apply text-spacing resilience overrides
steps: Together override line height to 1.5, paragraph spacing to 2em, letter spacing to .12em and word spacing to .16em where applicable.
Exercise labels, composer, buttons and dialog.
expected: No essential content clips, overlaps or disappears.
Language/script-specific applicability is recorded; these are test values, not mandated defaults.

scenarios.title: Measure actual pointer targets
steps: Measure target rectangles, including label activation area for switches.
Inspect adjacent target spacing at narrow width.
expected: Targets meet 24 by 24 CSS pixels or a documented applicable SC exception.
Icon glyph size is not confused with hit area.

scenarios.title: Preserve non-color meaning
steps: Inspect error, active selection, success and progress without relying on hue.
expected: Text, shape, position or another non-color cue conveys necessary meaning.
Selected semantics are exposed programmatically.

scenarios.title: Check forced-colors controls and focus
steps: Enable forced colors in a supported environment.
Toggle custom switches, selected segments and focus; inspect SVG icons and dialog boundaries.
expected: Controls and states remain identifiable when backgrounds/shadows are changed or removed.
The custom switch thumb/state is not dependent solely on suppressed paint.

scenarios.title: Respect reduced motion throughout
steps: Enable reduced motion before load and while the demo is running.
Trigger transitions, pending animations and auto-scrolling.
expected: Nonessential motion is suppressed or substantially reduced across CSS and JS paths.
Meaningful status remains available without motion.

scenarios.title: Check document language and structure
steps: Inspect page title, primary language, headings, landmarks and reading order.
Navigate headings/landmarks with assistive technology when available.
expected: Structure reflects the content and does not duplicate hidden decorative content.
Mixed-language content remains understandable.

scenarios.title: Open the documented local entry point
steps: Use the exact README instructions in a clean profile.
If double-click opening is promised, open the actual file:/// entry point without an HTTP server.
expected: The promised delivery mode loads CSS and JS and supports the core interaction.
No module/fetch/security restriction silently breaks file opening.

scenarios.title: Verify cold-cache offline operation
steps: Clear cache for the test context, block network, and reopen the demo.
Exercise theme, composer and dialog while inspecting requests.
expected: All essential assets and data are local.
External reference links are optional navigation; no hidden CDN, font or telemetry dependency exists.

scenarios.title: Recover from blocked storage
steps: Make localStorage access/get/set throw in a test context, or use a profile with storage blocked.
Load and use the demo; change theme and reload.
expected: Essential controls remain functional.
Persistence failure degrades gracefully; no unhandled startup exception occurs.

scenarios.title: Validate stale and malformed stored values
steps: Set unknown theme values, malformed JSON and wrong data types in demo-owned storage keys.
Reload, then change settings.
expected: Values are validated against supported options and safe defaults.
No executable content or corrupted UI is produced.

scenarios.title: Avoid destructive storage reset
steps: Place an unrelated sentinel key in the test origin.
Use any demo reset/clear action and inspect storage.
expected: Only demo-owned documented keys are removed.
The implementation does not use localStorage.clear() to reset one demo.

scenarios.title: Verify no hidden input transmission
steps: Inspect source for fetch, XHR, sockets, beacons, analytics, forms and dynamic remote assets.
Type a unique harmless sentinel and exercise the demo with network logging.
expected: No typed content leaves the local demo.
Source inspection and observed requests agree with the local/offline promise.

scenarios.title: Check console and asynchronous cleanup
steps: Repeat open/close/reset/submit sequences and inspect console errors and unhandled rejections.
Reload or navigate away during pending work.
expected: No accumulating listener, timer or promise failure corrupts behavior.
Completion callbacks cannot mutate a superseded session.

scenarios.title: Verify final release manifest and relative paths
steps: Copy only allowed publication files into a fresh directory with a different name/path.
Open using documented instructions and check all local links/assets.
expected: No accidental dependency on the research workspace or private assets exists.
Final hashes identify the reviewed artifact, not an earlier candidate.

scenarios.title: Prevent focus behind a narrow inspector overlay
steps: At 320 and 800 CSS-pixel widths, open the inspector.
Tab forward and backward through the resulting interface and dismiss the panel.
expected: No focused control is entirely hidden behind the inspector.
Its modal or disclosure model is consistent with focus management, semantics and background operability.
scenarios.applies_when: An inspector overlays main content at narrow widths.

scenarios.title: Keep essential controls reachable at short heights
steps: Use 800 by 350 and 320 by 400 CSS-pixel viewports; repeat with enlarged text.
Enter multiline content, trigger an error and reach sidebar bottom actions.
expected: Composer, error recovery and bottom navigation remain reachable through intended scrolling.
A fixed minimum height combined with body overflow does not strand essential controls.

scenarios.title: Reconcile navigation drawer semantics with modality
steps: Open the mobile drawer and traverse using Tab and a real screen reader where available.
Try background interaction, Escape and the close control.
expected: Visible scrim, background operability, focus containment and accessibility semantics express one coherent interaction model.
Closing restores usable focus without leaving inert or hidden content behind.
scenarios.applies_when: A scrim-backed navigation drawer is implemented.

publication_note: This is the historical reviewer scenario specification, not an execution ledger. Many scenarios remain unrun. The separate data/demo-state-test.json and data/demo-state-static.json cover only the documented simulated-DOM and static checks; their scenario mappings do not establish full browser scenario passes.
